data.title: Binance Stock Trading to Pause During Scheduled System Upgrade
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, U.S. Stock Trading will be temporarily unavailable during a scheduled system upgrade by its partner broker. Users will not be able to place stock trading orders during the upgrade.

The upgrade is scheduled for 2026-11-28 21:50 (UTC) - 2026-11-29 00:30 (UTC), outside U.S. regular market trading hours. Downtime is expected to remain within that window but could end earlier or extend if additional work is required. Stock trading services will resume automatically once the upgrade is complete.

For more information, please refer to Binance's official announcements.

data.title: Microsoft AI Chief Mustafa Suleyman: Safety and Alignment Research Is the Only Important Task Now
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing IT Home, Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman said on November 25 that the AI industry is crossing a threshold and that safety and alignment research is currently the only important work.

Suleyman said that before achieving AI alignment, priority should be given to ensuring humans can constrain model capabilities. The discussion also covered AI performance on math problems and safety tests involving sandbox escapes, exploits, and privilege acquisition.

data.title: SEB Says U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yields May Have Reached Cycle Peak, but Sustained Decline Is Premature
data.description: SEB analysts Jussi Hiljanen and Filip Carlsson said U.S. 10-year Treasury yields may have reached the peak of the current cycle, but it is too early to expect a sustained decline. According to Odaily, they said the bond rally since mid-November was driven mainly by stock-market selloffs, concerns about the risks of excessive monetary tightening, and falling inflation expectations. If risk appetite stabilizes, Treasury yields could rise again, while persistent safe-haven sentiment would support bond prices. The strategists said they were unwilling to bet on a sustained downtrend in yields before policy rates move closer to their peak.

data.title: Neuberger Fixed-Income Head Says New ECB President de Cos May Take a More Active Policy Approach
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Patrick Barbe, Neuberger’s head of European fixed income, said incoming European Central Bank President de Cos may take a more active leadership role, similar to Mario Draghi’s approach, rather than follow Christine Lagarde’s consensus-oriented decision-making style.

Barbe said this could make the ECB more responsive, tightening policy more quickly when inflation rises and easing it faster when economic growth weakens. He said responding early to rising inflation should help reduce interest-rate volatility. He also expects the ECB to communicate with markets more precisely while continuing to rely on forward guidance.

data.title: STOCKS | Shanghai Composite Reclaims 3,600 Points, Rises More Than 3.5%
data.description: The Shanghai Composite Index rose more than 3.5%, reclaiming the 3,600-point level. According to Odaily, semiconductors, lithography machines, CPO, software development, lidar and computing power stocks led gains, while more than 5,400 stocks rose across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.

data.title: Arthur Hayes Plans FLOP Chat Web App to Increase FLOP Network Usage
data.description: FLOP Network has 230 H100-equivalent computing units available for inference, but utilization is very low. According to Foresight News, Arthur Hayes said the team plans to launch a FLOP Chat web app where users can import or create a wallet, claim tokens, and interact with AI agents through a browser to complete tasks, in an experience similar to mainstream chatbots. Hayes said claiming FLOP tokens from the faucet has little value if they are not used.

data.title: STOCKS | A-Share Semiconductor Stocks Surge
data.description:
A-share semiconductor stocks surged, with Geehy Semiconductor, Yandong Microelectronics and Skyverse Technology among several stocks hitting their 20% daily limit. ChangXin Technology and Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corp. (SMIC) each gained more than 10%, while Cambricon rose more than 13%, returning to 1,000 yuan per share; GigaDevice, Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment, Hua Hong Semiconductor and Hygon Information Technology also advanced.

According to Odaily, regulators said they would focus more closely on national strategic priorities and provide more targeted support for high-quality technology companies seeking to list, while maintaining stable market operations.

data.title: Kenya Revenue Authority Proposes Expanded Crypto Customer and Transaction Data Reporting
data.description: Kenya’s tax authority has proposed requiring crypto platforms to report more customer identity and transaction data. According to Odaily, two draft measures would require qualifying crypto-asset service providers and financial institutions to share additional information with tax authorities. The 2026 Tax Procedures (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework) Regulations would require qualifying platforms to collect customers’ names, addresses, tax-residency status and taxpayer identification numbers, and report cryptocurrency purchases, sales, exchanges and transfers. Reports would also cover transfers to external wallets when the recipient’s status as another service provider or financial institution cannot be confirmed, as well as cryptocurrency payments for goods or services worth more than $50,000. The two drafts were published on November 25, with public consultation closing on December 8, 2026.

data.title: Scam Sniffer Reports Ethereum User Lost About 51,500 USDT in Poisoning Attack
data.description: An Ethereum user lost about 51,500 USDT in a poisoning attack. According to Foresight News, Scam Sniffer detected the incident.

data.title: Cyber Security Update: Cross-Chain Bridge Resumes, L2-Related Routes Remain Paused
data.description:
Cyber said its cross-chain bridge has resumed operations, while routes connected to Cyber L2 remain paused. According to Odaily, 14 routes spanning Ethereum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Base and Solana have reopened, and all passed end-to-end testing on mainnet.

All cross-chain transfers now require signatures from four independent verification networks (DVNs): LayerZero Labs and Canary are mandatory, along with any two of Google Cloud, Twinstake (Nethermind) and Horizen. Bridge permissions are controlled by a 3-of-5 multisig, and none of the DVNs are self-hosted.

data.title: Ripple’s XRP Ledger Vault Gets 29 Votes; Lending Feature Needs One More to Launch
data.description:
Ripple’s planned XRP Ledger lending system is nearing launch, with its vault feature receiving 29 votes in support while the lending feature remains one vote short. According to Odaily, 29 of 35 validator votes support the vault feature; if support holds for two weeks, it is expected to activate on December 9. The lending feature has 28 votes, exactly 80% of the total, and needs one more vote to begin its two-week activation countdown.

XRP Ledger holds about $837 million in stablecoins, while stablecoins in its DeFi applications total about $30.5 million, according to DefiLlama data. The system would let users deposit XRP or stablecoins into lending vaults in exchange for share tokens, with brokers lending funds to borrowers such as payment companies through term loans. Borrowers would not need to provide on-chain collateral; depositor protection would depend on brokers’ credit assessments and the capital they commit to absorb initial losses. Before the lending feature is activated, vaults can accept deposits and issue shares but cannot lend funds.

data.title: Elysium DEX Trading Volume Surpasses $1 Billion
data.description: Total trading volume on decentralized exchanges on Elysium has surpassed $1 billion. According to Foresight News, the Layer 2 network said in a post on X that its DEX trading volume had crossed the threshold.

data.title: Binance to Offer 1,000 USDC for Two Blockchain Week Challenges
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, two challenges tied to Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok will give participants a chance to share a total prize pool of 1,000 USDC in token vouchers. The activities invite the global community to share event experiences and recognize Binance Community Heroes.

The activity period runs from 2026-11-28 01:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-30 23:59 (UTC). Each challenge has a prize pool of 500 USDC in token vouchers.

For more information, please refer to Binance's official announcements.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Herman Jin: AI Is Not Broken, Liquidity Is; Semiconductor Turning Point May Come in Q1 2027
data.description: Former Goldman Sachs FICC executive Herman Jin said the AI and semiconductor pullback was driven by volatility in long-term interest rates that triggered credit tightening, rather than evidence that AI demand had weakened. According to PANews, Jin is watching for extreme positioning in Q1 2027 and demand validation from Vera Rubin.

data.title: Jeff Park: This Is the Toughest Bitcoin Cycle I Have Experienced
data.description: Jeff Park said this is the toughest Bitcoin cycle he has experienced. According to PANews, he said institutional trust is declining and surveillance is expanding, while Bitcoin has yet to chart an independent performance. Park said Bitcoin never promised a particular price, correlation, or catalyst; its promise was a permissionless alternative based on a fixed supply, censorship-resistant settlement, and ownership that does not depend on another party’s authorization. He said that promise remains intact and that Bitcoin is worth continuing to hold.

data.title: Deutsche Bank: Tech Selloff May Be Nearing Bottom as S&P 500 Is Forecast to Rise 25% to 9,000
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Deutsche Bank, the bank expects the S&P 500 to reach 9,000 by the end of 2027, up more than 25% from current levels, in its latest 2027 global outlook. That is the most bullish target among major Wall Street investment banks. Deutsche Bank says the technology stock selloff that began in mid-October may be nearing its end; similar market swings have historically taken an average of six to eight weeks to form a bottom.

The bank expects AI capital spending to continue supporting U.S. economic growth and corporate earnings. It forecasts 2027 earnings per share of $430 for S&P 500 companies, a 19% year-over-year increase. While capital spending growth by hyperscale cloud providers may peak next year, Deutsche Bank expects AI adoption and monetization to accelerate earnings growth. It projects those providers’ capital spending will rise from about $1 trillion in 2026 to $1.35 trillion in 2027.

Deutsche Bank expects AI investment, housing inflation, and resilient demand to slow the decline in inflation. It says the Federal Reserve may raise rates by 25 basis points in December 2026, January 2027, and March 2027, bringing the federal funds rate to 4.50%–4.75%. The bank also forecasts the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield will reach 5.05% by the end of 2027.

Deutsche Bank’s equity strategy team is bullish on technology stocks and U.S. equities. Its credit strategy team cautions that slower AI capital spending could pose market risks and recommends hedging with S&P 500 put options, while underweighting chipmakers, newer cloud computing companies, and data center-related credit assets.

data.title: SpaceX Shares Rise More Than 7% on Blue Ocean ATS After Musk Expands Donation Plan
data.description:
SpaceX shares rose more than 7% in overnight trading on Blue Ocean ATS after Elon Musk expanded his plan to donate shares to children in the United States. According to Odaily, Musk said he would donate an additional SpaceX share every year to every child in the country.

Blue Ocean ATS is an alternative trading system for U.S. stocks that operates from 8 p.m. to 4 a.m. Eastern time, outside regular market hours. Its holiday schedule says overnight trading will resume at 8 p.m. Eastern time on Thanksgiving.

data.title: STOCKS | South Korea’s KOSPI Rises 4% to 4,899.71; SK Hynix Gains 5%
data.description: South Korea’s KOSPI index rose 4% to 4,899.71 points. According to Odaily, SK Hynix gained 5%, while Samsung Electronics rose more than 4%.

data.title: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN to Form Working Group on Cross-Border Payments and Crypto Regulation
data.description:
China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN members have agreed to establish a working group on cross-border digital payments and digital asset regulation. According to Odaily, finance ministry and central bank deputies met in Kyoto, Japan, this week and agreed to establish an ASEAN+3 Macroeconomic Research Office (AMRO) cross-border digital payment project and a dedicated group to advance policy discussions, according to a joint statement released Thursday.

The decision follows a meeting in Uzbekistan in May this year, where the parties identified cross-border digital payments as a new area for cooperation and called for a specific cooperation mechanism by the end of 2026. Discussions will focus on connecting retail and wholesale payment systems and on a regulatory framework for stablecoins.

Finance ministers and central bank governors are expected to continue discussing the issues at their next meeting in Nagoya, Japan, in May 2027.

data.title: Binance to Support 0G (0G) BEP20 Contract Swap at a 1:1 Ratio
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, the exchange will support a contract swap for 0G (0G) on the BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) network at a 1:1 ratio. Binance will handle the technical requirements for users involved in the swap.

At 2026-11-30 15:00 (UTC), Binance will suspend deposits and withdrawals of 0G tokens via the old BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) network. The old 0G (BEP20) tokens will no longer be supported for deposits or withdrawals after that time. Binance will open deposits and withdrawals for the new 0G (BEP20) tokens once the swap is complete, without further notice.

Spot, Margin, Futures trading and Binance Earn services will not be affected during the contract swap.

The new 0G token contract address on the BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) network is 0G (0x2C2d4d99F95643C8EC2EbD1d73a6Fd0273068B1e). The old 0G token contract address on the network is 0G (0x4B948d64dE1F71fCd12fB586f4c776421a35b3eE).

For more information, please refer to Binance's official announcements.
